citation: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (Act 26 of 2012, 2020 Rev Ed)

source.note: Part VIA (Notification of Data Breaches) was inserted by the Personal Data Protection (Amendment) Act 2020. Related instruments cited by the encoding: the Personal Data Protection (Notification of Data Breaches) Regulations, and the PDPC Advisory Guidelines on Key Concepts, Part 20.
